assumptions: For any field k, integers n>=2,m>=2, and the commutative unital quotient k[x_1,...,x_n]/(x_i^m). Aut means the full affine group scheme, not only its k-points or reduced group.
scientific_integrity: Symbolic proof of tangent dimension, dimension comparison, and infinitesimal translations. Small finite-field enumerations supplement but do not establish infinite claims. No external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify the reduced group for composite exponents divisible by the characteristic. The m=p^e finite-field count is a supporting special case, and its m=p height-one situation is documented in prior literature. The complete smoothness criterion is a claim of the present work subject to external priority review.
title: A sharp smoothness boundary for automorphism schemes of box-truncated polynomial algebras
